parameters.name: CredName
parameters.description: The credential name. Only the following value is supported: 0501 (product image).

parameters.name: CredType
parameters.description: The credential type. Only the following value is supported: 05 (product image).

parameters.name: ImageFile
parameters.description: The InputStream object of the image.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The call mode. Only the following value is supported: ANTI_FAKE_CHECK.
